verdict.rationale: Flagsmith is a feature-flag management platform, not an AI agent or assistant host, so consuming tools from external MCP servers (the MCP-client role) is a category error for this product type. Its documented MCP Server is the opposite role: it exposes Flagsmith's Admin API to outside AI assistants. That server-side evidence does not transfer to this client-side story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
